tickets.text: I opposed ADVANCE. On my taxonomy (C2) this is a RETRACEMENT set-up that has not yet retraced: HH/HL on W, D and H1, D close 44.44 well over ema21 41.68. An hourly close over yesterday's high buys the extension, not the first pullback (C7 shape, ADX not served). I sign WATCH with the trigger armed only after a first pullback toward the rising 20-day prints.

I opposed ADVANCE. H1 closed at 99% of the day's range after a run: a close on the high is climax risk (C19, C11), and the RETRACEMENT family (C2) buys the first pullback, not the bar after it. I sign WATCH with the hourly trigger armed only after a first pullback toward ema21 (D); wrong if a reversal bar off the high closes back under yesterday's low.

Held name: before any add, a windfall or range-expansion bar off the high is protected first (C19) - take partial profit and trail a tight stop under the latest swing low (C17) rather than let the open gain erode. The add is a fresh set-up, not a reason to hold through a climax bar.

A flag off a thrust is a breakout-family trade (C2, C12; bar-range history not served) measured in bars and days, not weeks (C18): partial profits should come early, and a climax or range-expansion bar after entry is an exit-all signal (C19), whatever the 20-session horizon says.
